image_description: A close-up of a circular, brass-rimmed nautical-style instrument cluster mounted on a blue background. The device features a large central clock face labeled 'SHIP'S TIME' and three smaller sub-dials: one labeled 'BAROMETER', one 'HUMIDITY', and one 'THERMOMETER'. The casing appears to be wood with brass fittings. There is a semi-transparent watermark text 'Bargain Resource' at the bottom.
